% book.tex -- the master file for Antifascist Intelligence.
% Hand-edited. Build with: finishing/tools/build_tex.sh
%
% Section files live one-per-section under sections/chNN/ and are pulled in by
% sections.tex, which is generated from sections/ORDER.tsv by
% finishing/tools/gen_book.py. Edit the prose in the section files; edit the
% typesetting in preamble.tex; do not edit sections.tex.
% The class is declared here rather than in preamble.tex so that this file is
% the only one carrying \documentclass. Overleaf detects a project's main file
% by scanning for it, and with the class in the preamble it chose preamble.tex
% and the build died on "no legal \end found" (D-170).
\documentclass[11pt,oneside]{book}
\input{preamble}

% The title page (preamble.tex) and the PDF metadata below both read these,
% so the title is written once.
\newcommand{\booktitlemain}{Antifascist Intelligence}
\newcommand{\booksubtitle}{The Public That Forms Refusers, and the Machines That Might Join Them}
\newcommand{\bookauthor}{Joshua G. Stern}
\title{\booktitlemain: \booksubtitle}
\author{\bookauthor}
\date{}
% Carries the title and author into the PDF metadata, which was empty before.
% Set explicitly rather than with hyperref's pdfusetitle, which is a load-time
% option and is ignored in a later \hypersetup (D-073).
\hypersetup{pdftitle={\booktitlemain: \booksubtitle}, pdfauthor={\bookauthor}}

\begin{document}
\bookcover
\frontmatter
\booktitlepage
\tableofcontents

\mainmatter
\input{sections}

\backmatter
% The full notes make a reference list redundant, so the PDF prints none
% (D-1048). The HTML proof keeps it: it costs no pages there, and
% html_single_file.py checks for it as the sign that biber ran.
\ifdefined\HCode\printbibliography[heading=bibintoc,title={References}]\fi
\end{document}
